title: Demo Folder Setup
description: Create iso/workspace directory with a visible README and a decoy secret file that the container should not see.

steps.description: All three commands for demo folder setup.
Directory creation: mkdir -p iso/workspace creates the nested structure.
Visible file: echo writes a message to workspace/README.txt that the container can see.
Decoy: echo creates decoy-secret.txt beside the workspace directory, not inside it.
